info.title: V2X MEC Partner API
info.description: API for Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC) services. This Partner API provides endpoints for ETX registration, V2X Message Deposit, and authentication services.

tags.name: Path Management
tags.description: Path management endpoints for GeoJSON-like path data

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: ETX client registration endpoints for the MQTT Broker

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Authentication and authorization for Registration and Configuration endpoints

tags.name: TIM Configuration
tags.description: TIM ITIS phrases and metadata configuration endpoints

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: ETX client registration and connection management endpoints

tags.name: Vendor Limits Management
tags.description: Endpoints for managing vendor-wide registration limits

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Authentication and authorization for Registration and Deposit endpoints

tags.name: User Limits Management
tags.description: Endpoints for managing user registration limits

tags.name: Deposit
tags.description: V2X Message Deposit endpoints for deployment to the ETX MQTT Broker

get.description: Checks the registration status of a device by its device ID against the ETX API

parameters.name: DeviceID
parameters.description: Device ID to check registration status for

put.description: Updates an existing ETX client registration. This endpoint supports retry logic for handling pending registration updates. The client must provide a valid device ID for successful registration update.

parameters.name: retry
parameters.description: Enable retry logic for pending registration updates

parameters.name: num_retries
parameters.description: Number of retry attempts for pending updates

parameters.name: num_sec_to_sleep
parameters.description: Seconds to sleep between retry attempts

post.description: Registers a new ETX client with the system. This endpoint supports retry logic for handling pending registrations. The client must provide valid client type and subtype information for successful registration.

parameters.name: retry
parameters.description: Enable retry logic for pending registrations

parameters.name: num_retries
parameters.description: Number of retry attempts for pending registrations

parameters.name: num_sec_to_sleep
parameters.description: Seconds to sleep between retry attempts

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific geofence by its ID. This endpoint returns the complete geofence configuration including geometry, properties, and metadata.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the geofence

put.description: Updates an existing geofence with new configuration. All fields in the request will replace the existing geofence configuration.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the geofence to update

post.description: Creates a new geofence with the specified configuration. The geofence can be used for V2X traffic management and safety applications.

delete.description: Deletes a geofence from the system. This operation is irreversible and will remove all associated configuration and data.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the geofence to delete

post.description: Performs both client registration and connection establishment in a single operation. This endpoint first registers the client with the system, then establishes a connection using the returned device ID. This is a convenience endpoint that combines the functionality of both registration and connection endpoints.

parameters.name: num_retries
parameters.description: Number of retry attempts for pending registrations

parameters.name: num_sec_to_sleep
parameters.description: Seconds to sleep between retry attempts

400.description: Bad request - invalid registration or connection data

500.description: Internal server error - registration or connection failed

get.description: Retrieves all active paths in GeoJSON-like format. This endpoint returns a collection of paths with their coordinates, timestamps, and metadata.

post.description: Creates a new path with GeoJSON-like structure, or updates an existing path if one with the same name already exists. Only administrators can create/update paths.

Deposits V2X message data to the database. This endpoint is used to deploy V2X messages (TIM, MAP, etc.) with geospatial information. The configuration must include geofence overrides to define the deployment area. Vendor ID is automatically determined from the user's JWT token based on their role.

409.description: Conflict - no available geohash or conflicting state

413.description: Payload too large - exceeds maximum allowed geohashes

delete.description: Deletes geofence deployments associated with a specific identifier. This endpoint allows for manual removal of geofence deployments by their identifier. The system will deactivate the geofence deployment by setting is_active to false. This follows REST best practices by using query parameters for resource identification.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Geofence identifier to delete

404.description: Not found - no geofence found with the specified identifier

post.description: Manually triggers the cleanup process to deactivate expired Geofence deployments. This endpoint is useful for testing and immediate cleanup without waiting for the scheduled task.
Establishes a connection for an ETX client with location and network information. This endpoint is used to register device location and network connectivity for V2X communication.
Clears deployed geofences from the ETX. If set to only TIM messages it will clear all inactive TIMs.This operation can be used to remove multiple geofences at once.

get.description: Retrieves all vendor limits (Admin only)

post.description: Creates new vendor limits or updates existing ones. Vendor limits control the total number of registrations a vendor can have across all users (Admin only)

get.description: Retrieves all user limits (Admin only)

post.description: Creates new user limits or updates existing ones. Sets personal registration limits for a specific user (Admin only)

Authenticates a user with Keycloak and returns an access token. This endpoint is used for user authentication and obtaining JWT tokens for subsequent API calls. **Note: This endpoint does not require authentication.**

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid parameters

get.description: Downloads a TAR.GZ file containing all TIM icons for the specified version. This endpoint returns all available icons for the given version in a compressed tar.gz archive.

200.description: TIM icons TAR.GZ file downloaded successfully

get.description: Retrieves the TIM ITIS phrases and metadata configuration. This endpoint returns the configuration JSON containing TIM phrases, their codes, graphics, and overlay information along with a version number that correlates to a downloadable ZIP file of icons.
Retrieves secret configuration including tokens and S3 settings.

get.summary: Clean up old registrations for vendor
get.description: Cleans up old registrations for a specific vendor (Admin only)
Retrieves a specific path by its ID in GeoJSON-like format.

delete.description: Soft deletes a path by setting it as inactive. Only administrators can delete paths.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all Geofence deployments that have expired. This endpoint is useful for monitoring and debugging expiration issues.
Retrieves the current status of the Geofence expiration cleanup service, including the cleanup interval and whether the service is enabled.

200.description: Geofence cleanup service status retrieved successfully

get.description: Retrieves all active Geofence deployments from the database. This endpoint returns a list of all currently active Geofence deployments with their configuration details, geospatial information, and metadata.
Retrieves a specific Geofence deployment by its Geofence ID. This endpoint returns the complete configuration and metadata for the specified Geofence deployment.

parameters.name: geofenceId
parameters.description: Geofence ID to retrieve

get.summary: Get geohashes for a Geofence deployment
get.description: Retrieves all geohashes associated with a specific Geofence deployment. This endpoint is useful for understanding the geographical coverage of a particular Geofence deployment.

parameters.name: geofenceId
parameters.description: Geofence ID to get geohashes for

get.description: Retrieves all active Geofence deployments deployed by a specific user. This endpoint is useful for user-specific Geofence management and auditing.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username to filter by

get.description: Retrieves all Geofence deployments that cover a specific geohash. This endpoint is useful for finding Geofences relevant to a particular geographical area based on geohash precision.

parameters.name: geohash
parameters.description: Geohash to search for

get.description: Retrieves all Geofence deployments that have expired. This endpoint is useful for monitoring and debugging expiration issues.
Retrieves a list of all available geofence IDs in the ETX. This endpoint returns summary information for all configured geofences in the ETX without the full geofence details.

200.description: List of geofence summaries retrieved successfully

get.summary: Get vendor limits by vendor ID
get.description: Retrieves vendor limits for a specific vendor (Admin only)

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Vendor ID to get limits for

delete.description: Deletes vendor limits for a specific vendor (Admin only)

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Vendor ID to delete limits for

get.summary: Get user limits by vendor ID
get.description: Retrieves user limits for a specific vendor (Admin only)

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Vendor ID to get limits for

get.description: Retrieves user limits for a specific username (Admin only)

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username to get limits for

delete.description: Deletes user limits for a specific user and vendor (Admin only)

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username to delete limits for

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Vendor ID to delete limits for

DeviceID.description: Unique identifier for the device to update registration

GeofenceFeature.description: GeoJSON Feature representing a single geometric element within a geofence

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry object defining the spatial extent

properties.description: Properties object is required and must be an empty object. No content is allowed in the properties object. Must be an empty JSON object: {}. Any properties within this object will cause validation to fail. This field enforces that the properties object contains no key-value pairs.

GeofenceFeatureCollection.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection representing a geofence area

features.description: Array of GeoJSON features defining the geofence geometry

lat.description: Latitude coordinate of the device location

long.description: Longitude coordinate of the device location

PathRequest.description: Path request for creating or updating paths

updatedBy.description: User who last updated the path

DepositRequest.description: Request model for V2X message deposit

asn1_hex.description: UPER-encoded MessageFrame containing a MAP or TIM V2X Message in hexadecimal format

override_geofence.description: Override Geofence for ETX deployment. If not set, the geofence will be extracted from the provided message

id.description: Database ID of the Geofence deployment

geofence_id.description: Unique identifier for the Geofence deployment

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection representation of the deployment area

hex_payload.description: ASN.1 encoded message in hexadecimal format

deployed_by.description: Username of the person who deployed the Geofence

is_active.description: Whether the Geofence deployment is currently active

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Geofence was deployed

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Geofence was last updated

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the Geofence deployment

geohashes.description: List of geohashes covering the deployment area

lat.description: Latitude coordinate of the device location

long.description: Longitude coordinate of the device location

maxRegistrations.description: Maximum number of total registrations this vendor can have across all users
Maximum total registrations this vendor can have across all users

updatedBy.description: User who last updated the limits

maxRegistrations.description: Maximum number of registrations this specific user can have (personal limit)
Maximum registrations this specific user can have (personal limit)

updatedBy.description: User who last updated the limits

PathsResponse.description: Response containing multiple paths in GeoJSON-like format

BearerAuth.description: Keycloak JWT Bearer Token. Required for all endpoints except decode endpoints. Obtain a token from the /auth/token endpoint using your credentials.
